description: The HIVE Stand-Alone Cervical System by NanoHive is a unique solution for stand-alone fixation in the ACDF procedure. It utilizes both a zero-profile spacer with integrated screw fixation or a small anterior minimal-profile plate that is fixed to the spacer for easy rapid fixation. The spacer features a unique internal architecture that allows independent endplates that reduces device stiffness and allows new bone growth to be under load.
